methods.name: public Builder setName(@Nullable CharSequence name)
methods.comment:
* Sets the user visible name of this group. * * You can rename this group when the system locale changes by listening for the * {@link Intent#ACTION_LOCALE_CHANGED} broadcast. * *

The recommended maximum length is 40 characters; the value may be truncated if it * is too long.

methods.name: public Builder setDescription(@Nullable String description)
methods.comment:
* Sets the user visible description of this group. * *

The recommended maximum length is 300 characters; the value may be truncated if it * is too * long.
